question: Which tunnel has been built with ultra-modern specifications in the Pir Panjal range of the Himalayas at an altitude of 3000 meters above Mean Sea Level?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Tunnel.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Tunnel is a 9.02 km long highway tunnel built under the Rohtang Pass in the Pir Panjal range of the Himalayas in Himachal Pradesh, India.**
 
• It is the **world's longest highway tunnel** above an altitude of **3,000 meters.**
 
• The tunnel is named after former Prime Minister of India, **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**, who initiated the project in** 2002** and inaugurated it in **2020.**
 
• The tunnel connects Manali to **Lahaul-Spiti Valley** throughout the year and reduces the distance between the two regions by about** 46 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawahar Tunnel is a 2.5 km long road tunnel on the National Highway 44 in Jammu and Kashmir, India.**

 
 
• It is located at an altitude of **2,194 meters** and connects **Banihal **with** Qazigund.**
 
 
 
• **Syama Prasad Mookerjee Tunnel is also known as the Chenani-Nashri Tunnel.**
 
 
• It is a **9.28 km **long road tunnel on the National Highway 44 in **Jammu and Kashmir,** India.
 
• It is located at an altitude of **1,200 meters** and connects **Chenani **with** Nashri.**
 
 
 
• **Bhatan Tunnel is a 1.6 km long railway tunnel on the Konkan Railway route in Maharashtra, India.**
 
 
• It is located at an altitude of **70 meters** and connects the villages of **Bhatan and Kamathe.**
